name: paperclip-plugin-deal-desk
description: Deal numbers for buying a business: earnings periods, an add-back schedule with evidence, and the Acquisition Analyzer calculator (sources and uses, debt service, DSCR, ten-year projection, equity IRR) as saved, never-edited scenarios. Add-backs cannot be accepted without an evidence document, and a seller-claimed scenario cannot be saved before a conservative one.
author: Barry Carr & Tony Allard
